SYSTEM OVERVIEW

Anatomy of Invisible Grills

A closer look at the materials and structure used in residential invisible safety grill installations.

CABLE & PROFILE STRUCTURE

Component Breakdown

1

Protective Outer Casing

Transparent protective casing shields the wire from outdoor weathering and dust accumulation while ensuring smooth handling.

2

Stainless Steel Cable Core

Wound stainless steel wire cables designed for residential balcony and window safety containment.

3

Aluminium Track System

Sturdy extruded aluminium tracks mounted into concrete perimeter walls and slabs to hold cable tension securely.

CABLE MATERIAL
Stainless Steel

Durable stainless steel wire cables suitable for outdoor residential environments.

SAFETY PURPOSE
Fall Prevention

Designed to help prevent accidental falls from residential balconies and windows.

ANCHORING SYSTEM
Concrete Anchors

Fasteners secured into concrete slabs and structural frames for steady, reliable fitting.

OPEN VIEW
Uninterrupted Vistas

Slim vertical or horizontal cables maintain natural airflow, daylight, and skyline vistas.

HARDWARE ANATOMY

Precision Track & Anchorage System

A cable is only as dependable as the anchoring tracks holding it under tension.

6063-T6 Structural Aluminium

Extruded from architectural grade aluminum-magnesium-silicon alloy, heat treated to T6 temper for durable yield strength and zero warping under continuous cable tension.

Hard Anodized Protective Finish

25-micron electrochemical oxide coat prevents aluminum oxidation, matching the subtle architectural hues of modern balcony frames.

Concealed Locking Track Cover

A snap-fit aesthetic cover completely conceals anchor screw heads and tension barrels, shielding internal components from rainwater and dust accumulation.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Installation & Materials FAQ

Straightforward, practical information about invisible grill installation, balcony safety, and building society approvals.

How long does installation take, and what is the process? +
A standard residential balcony takes approximately 3 to 5 hours to install. Our 4-step workflow: 1) Complimentary site measurement and sample demonstration, 2) Upfront transparent quotation, 3) Precision installation by an experienced rigging team equipped with proper safety gear, 4) Final alignment check and client sign-off.
What safety equipment do your technicians use during high-rise installations? +
Our on-site technicians follow established work-at-height safety practices. Each technician uses safety harnesses attached to secure anchor points, safety helmets, and tethered tools to ensure secure, accident-free installations.
